note: Adapted from the original German description of Holmgren & Holmgren 1915, published as Calotermes (Procryptotermes?) canalensis n. sp., type locality Canala, New Caledonia, collected on 1911-10-30. The original treats only the alate; the soldier and worker are unknown, and because no soldier was available the authors could not decide whether the species belongs in the subgenus Cryptotermes or in Procryptotermes, although its slender shape approaches Glyptotermes and they incline to the latter. Wing-vein branch numbers and segment numbers are transcribed as given.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head pale brown, the ventral surface yellow, wings brownish with the costa darker; vestiture sparse, the wing surface densely punctate. Head quadrangular-oval; compound eyes medium-sized, not much projecting; ocelli medium-sized, almost touching the compound eye; antennae 16-segmented, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3, segments 3 and 4 equal in length, the segments gradually longer from segment 9 onwards. Pronotum about as wide as the head, transversely quadrangular with rounded corners, the anterior margin concave. Wings long and narrow: the radius extends beyond the first quarter of the wing; radial sector with 7—8 anterior branches; media long and unbranched, joining the radial sector in the last quarter of the wing; cubitus not strongly marked, with 14—15 mostly unbranched branches. Cerci short; the male with stylus-like appendages. Measurements: body length with wings 8.5 mm, without wings 5 mm, forewing length 7 mm, head width 0.91 mm, pronotum width 0.91 mm, length 0.49 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Soldier and worker unknown. Type locality Canala, New Caledonia, collected on 1911-10-30; the original authors, on account of its slender shape resembling Glyptotermes, incline to place it in the subgenus Procryptotermes, but could not decide for lack of a soldier.
